messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Apple ID account did not renew today, because we were unable to authorize your card number.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', "We're about to move you from BT email to our new email service called BT Mail Service.", 'Our recent attempts to set up a new tax refund order was incomplete.', 'We received your request to delete your (yoursfaithfully2333@outlook.com) account permanently.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We manage subscriptions, orders, and account services by notifying you of renewals, cancellations, service transitions, incomplete requests, and account deletion."}
